'''Conan deep roots''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] which grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cona/Legends|Cona]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==History==
The plant species grew roots deep in Cona's soil where the planet's native sentient species, the Arcona, dug for the roots from within their communal nests and used them as a source of food and water.

==Appearances==
*''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]''
